prompts.prompt: Create one gorgeous landscape 3 by 2 compilation character reference sheet for KERNEL KEEP, an original digital fortress RTS. Use attached art as STYLE REFERENCE only: graphite armor, cyan emissive circuit seams, amber industrial tools, geometric faceted science fiction programs. Exact six roles, single fully visible model per large spacious cell, consistent 3/4 full-body pose and neutral dark studio backgrounds. Row one: RUNNER a compact worker android carrying a luminous data cube with construction tool; PING a very light two-legged fast scout with swept antennae; BULWARK a broad heavy defensive android with angular physical shield. Row two: LANCER a lean ranged android with long precision energy lance rifle; PATCHER a white and graphite support android with articulated repair tool and little drone; BREAKER a low four-legged heavy siege artillery walker with amber cannon. Clearly distinguish all six silhouettes, readable even without color. Consistent visually buildable stylized game-model aesthetic, slightly simplified rather than microscopic filigree. Title KERNEL KEEP / SIX PROGRAM ROLES. One exact role label below each character. No extra units, commander, miner role, no stats. This is modeling/concept reference, not a sprite atlas. Fine thin cyan grid dividers, large artwork, clean typography, no watermark.

Create a beautiful landscape concept board for KERNEL KEEP with EXACTLY TEN isometric buildings, a 5-column by 2-row spacious grid. Attached image is STYLE reference only: original black graphite digital fortresses with restrained cyan circuit inlays and amber production interiors. CONSISTENT camera and lighting, plain navy backgrounds and clean modular foundations, each whole building visible in its cell, labels short and crisp. Title KERNEL KEEP / TEN STRUCTURES. Top row: CORE monumental cubic luminous heart surrounded by four spires; DATA CACHE low accessible storage depot with blue data crates; COMPILER broad manufacturing structure with three cyan code vats and output bay; MINING RIG amber extraction machinery drilling fictional crystal vein; COMPUTE NODE squat square high performance server block with four obvious cooling towers and cyan central chip. Bottom row: MEMORY BANK visibly distinct tall slim three stacked crystalline data slabs with violet accents and graphite chassis; TRAINING GRID a low open rectangular practice yard with three training pylons and hangar entrance; FIREWALL modular straight solid wall section with corner piece, cyan seams, NOT fire; ACCESS GATE monumental matching gate with fully clear open entrance and retractable door; SENTRY TOWER compact raised platform with long rotating energy turret. Use these EXACT labels, no research lab, repair station, extra buildings, or stats. Distinguish silhouettes especially Compute Node vs Memory Bank vs Core. Practical beautiful concept art for 2.5D sprite production, no busy scenery and no real crypto logo.

Attached image is visual style reference: black graphite geometric architecture, cyan circuitry, amber industry. NO TEXT AT ALL, no UI, no letters, no logos. Composition: reserve the LEFT 42 percent as very dark quiet navy atmospheric negative space for menu overlay, with faint restrained circuit lines only. On RIGHT 58 percent, spectacular isometric towering Core keep with a bright cyan cubic energy heart, angular walls and open gate, amber compiler/mining buildings, a few tiny marching robotic programs and a broad elevated bridge crossing a deep digital divide. Strong refined silhouette, intentional void gaps, dark synthetic plateaus, no trees, no natural grass. Background tall digital towers recede into blue haze. Warm amber accents balance luminous cyan. Sophisticated restrained bloom, hand crafted detailed game key art, rich dimensional depth, readable masses, no excessive visual noise or fireworks. Lower corners dark enough for footer copy. Entire scene must be original and coherent with supplied architecture, not recognizable movie architecture. This will be used as a real local app menu asset, clean finished illustration.
